items.source: Setting a custom-configured Jsonb is one way to take further control of the JSON serialization process.
items.translation: 设置自定义配置的Jsonb是进一步控制 JSON 序列化过程的一种方式。

items.source: Template method that reads the JSON-bound object from the given Reader.
items.translation: 读取给定Reader中 JSON 绑定对象的模板方法。

items.source: Template method that writes the JSON-bound object to the given Writer.
items.translation: 将绑定到 JSON 的对象写入给定的 Writer 的模板方法。

items.source: This converter can be used to bind to typed beans or untyped HashMaps. By default, it supports application/json and application/*+json with UTF-8 character set.
items.translation: 此转换器可用于绑定到类型化 bean 或未类型化的 `HashMap`。默认情况下，它支持带有`UTF-8`字符集的`application/json`和`application/*+json`。

items.source: The default implementation returns false.
items.translation: 默认实现返回false。
